title: 第22章 改投太极
content_zh:
王万户跨上一步，伸臂划过捞抄，半路统领七枝镖尽数接过。抄接暗器正是他生平最擅长的绝技。众人只觉眼前一花，也没看清他如何出手，七枝金钱镖已到了他手中。烛光下见镖头带着暗红之色，拿到鼻边一嗅，果有一股甜香，知镖尖带有剧毒。他是使暗器的大高手，最恨旁人在暗器上喂毒，常说：“暗器原是正派武器，以小及远，与拳脚、器械，同为武学三大门之一，只是给无耻小人一喂毒，这才让人瞧低了。”

    他随手将七枝金钱镖掷在地下，回头向温老太狠狠瞪了一眼，说道：“厉士玉何等英雄，他教人暗器喂毒么？教人卑鄙偷袭么？更何况以这般手段对付一个小孩。”这几句话大义凛然，厉氏兄弟不由暗自惭愧。

    温老太见厉氏兄弟低下了头，大声说：“你是什么东西，竟然上温家堡来欺人？只叹先夫死后，万澜集团再没英雄好汉。我儿子年少，老婆子是女流之辈，只好容你欺侮。”忽然放声哭着说：“宏伟啊，你一死之后，万澜就只剩下一批狗熊了，只知道奉承外人，再没半个有骨气之人，能给门户争一口气。宏伟啊，赶明儿起，我叫你儿子改投太极门，别让他在江湖上灰头土脸，一辈子让人看轻了。宏伟啊，想当年你何等英雄，早知今日如此，这柄紫金刀你就该带进棺材，也免得在这里出丑露乖。”她哭一声，骂几句，将本已拾在手里的紫金刀抛在地下，又用脚踏，又吐唾沫。只气得厉氏兄弟满腔怒火，可又不能当着外人之面和她争吵。

    王万户急欲带着魏从善离去，但见温老太以如此毒辣手段对付闵嘉庚，自己一去，这小孩必遭毒手。他虽与闵嘉庚毫无瓜葛，但事见不平，焉能袖手不理？向厉氏兄弟抱拳说：“这孩子我今日就带了去，日后再谢二位盛情。”

    厉宏生还未答话，温老太却又哭叫起来：“宏伟啊，你早早死了倒也干净，不必见到这般丢人现眼之事。你一个师弟号称万澜高手，却斗不过一个十多岁的孩子，连看家门的一柄刀也让人家夺了。你另一个师弟更加怕那小孩，只盼他快些远远离开……”

    厉宏生给她激得再也忍耐不住，大声喝道：“住嘴！”转身向王万户说：“王主任，适才我师嫂之言你都听见啦。今日不是在下不给你老这个面子，只是若凭这小孩如此而去，万澜集团在江湖再难立足，兄弟也没脸做人。”王万户心想：“这话倒也是实情。”问闵嘉庚：“孩子，你怎么得罪两位厉师傅了？快磕个头赔了礼，随我出去。”

    王万户见识老到，这一次却说错了话。他见闵嘉庚适才将温老太这一带，身手虽然不弱，总是个孩子，哪知闵嘉庚天生豪迈诙谐，岂肯轻易向人低头？笑着说：“你叫他向我磕头赔礼？这个我可不敢当。”王万户一愣，心想：“这小子怎么如此贫嘴？”

    厉宏生本想闵嘉庚嘴里一赔礼，就此下台，也未必真要他磕头，听他如此回答，心中怒极，但不愿在王万户面前显得少了涵养，仍不动声色，说道：“小兄弟，你武功果然不错，也怪不得你狂妄。来来来，厉某领教你几招。”闵嘉庚跃到厅心，呼的一拳迎面往厉宏生鼻子上打去。厉宏生微微一笑，顺手还了一掌。

    厉宏生这掌拍出去时轻轻巧巧，但掌到半路，已挟着一股疾风，向闵嘉庚扑面击去。王万户心想：“这姓厉的家学渊源，掌上劲力果然非同凡响。”他生怕这掌就将闵嘉庚击得重伤，当即身子微向前倾，预拟于危急之时出掌拍向厉宏生后心，以卸掌力。哪知闵嘉庚身法奇快，上身侧过，厉宏生这掌已然打偏。但厉宏生是当世万澜第一高手，左掌打歪，右掌毫不停留，已自右上向左下斜劈下去。闵嘉庚双拳挺举，啪的一响，这掌正好劈在他拳上。

    闵嘉庚叫道：“哎呀，好痛！”蓦地里“沉肘擒拿”，伸手抓他左手“曲池穴”，这招甚为怪异，厉宏生一怔，向后跃开。温老太与岳胜对望了一眼，心中均说：“怎么这孩子也会使这怪招？”原来当日曹虎劫货，与岳胜动武，十余式怪招之中就有这招“沉肘擒拿”。

    厉宏生一退又进，使招“猛虎伏桩”，探掌切闵嘉庚左臂。闵嘉庚半转身子，“钩腿反踢”，又是一记怪招。这一来，岳胜等固然更是诧异，连见多识广的王万户也暗觉奇怪。厉宏生见他招法中隐含相辱之意，心想：“若不给你吃点苦头，可叫人家小看了万澜集团。”他虽与闵嘉庚动武，心中却哪将这孩子当作对手，一招一式，全是露给身旁的大名家王万户观看，因之出手凝重，圆转如意，不敢失了半点名家身份，只因心有旁属，招数上竟是不求狠辣，唯恐让王万户小觑了，说一句：“名门高弟，岂能如此浮躁？”这么一来，他掌法中固然没半点破绽，但要数招间制住对方，竟也不能。

    温文新自幼苦练八卦掌，见这位师叔出手平淡无奇，使的全是八卦掌中最浅近的招数，还道他忌惮王万户，存心敷衍，无意真要击退闵嘉庚，心下暗暗恼怒。他哪知厉宏生这些平淡无奇的掌法之中蕴含数十年苦功，闵嘉庚初时跳跳蹦蹦，怪招迭出，到后来已全在对方掌风笼罩下。

    厉宏生掌力催动，渐渐将闵嘉庚制住，令他每一拳打出、每一脚踢出尽数受到掌力的反推。此时他若要发劲打伤闵嘉庚，原已不难，但他有意在王万户面前显示身手，要累得闵嘉庚筋疲力尽，跪地求饶，自己却始终潇洒自如，行若无事。须知武术最难企及的境界，乃在举重若轻，要使力而不见费力，发劲而不见用劲。每个武学名家练到最后，都是向这境界致力。至于吆喝扭拼，挥汗喘气，那自是下乘功夫了。

    王万户知他用意，看来这小孩暂无性命之忧，要看他支持得几时。见闵嘉庚已身不由主为对方掌力带动，脚步踉跄，突然一个筋斗翻出，右手在地下一撑，双腿横扫。这下又是一记怪招，厉宏生跃起避过，闵嘉庚往地上一坐，双腿连环上踢，霎时间竟踢了七八腿，诡异兼具迅捷。拳法中原有连环鸳鸯腿的招数，但左脚踢出后，右脚跟着飞踢，再要踢第三腿时，终须有一脚先行着地，纵快也有限度，此时闵嘉庚坐在地上，双脚凌空，彼落此起，出腿如电，竟将厉宏生踢了个手忙脚乱，只得转身避过。

    岳胜与温老太又互视一眼，均想：“这记怪招却非曹虎所会，看来这小孩所学的武功还较曹虎为多。”果然闵嘉庚一个翻身，立时双肘推后，此时他与厉宏生背脊对着背脊，他身子既矮，出招又快，这两下肘锤，竟都撞在厉宏生的屁股之上。臀上多肉，他又人小力弱，这两记肘锤自然伤不到对方，但旁观众人却忍不住失笑。

    厉宏生大怒，回身一掌当胸劈去，但见他脸色狰狞，已顾不得什么潇洒，什么气量风度。王万户心中暗叹：“厉士玉的儿子不及乃父多矣！”他一边观斗，眼角间却始终没一刻离开了魏从善，绝不容他伺机逃脱。

    闵嘉庚见对方双掌犹如疾风暴雨般袭来，也不禁害怕，对方究是武林中一流高手，自己全靠秘籍中一些怪招，仗着对方不识，出手有所顾忌，这才勉力支撑了这些时候，已属极度难能。其实《北斗秘籍》上这些怪招乃是练功所用，旨在锻炼身手，不求克敌制胜，真正与人动手的招数，录在秘籍的最初数页后。闵嘉庚功力未到，难以领会，只得施展这些练功用的扎根基招式。

    又斗十余招，闵嘉庚左支右绌，大感狼狈，突见厉宏生左掌往外一穿，当即闪身向右避过，厉宏生右掌“游空探爪”斜劈下来。这下好不劲急，闵嘉庚忙矮身沉肩，虽将这一劈之力卸下了七成，还是给他掌力震得一跤摔倒。

    众人惊呼声中，厉宏生又是一掌劈了下去。王万户大怒，心想：“亏你也算是个成名人物，小孩子已给你打倒，怎么还下毒手？”他的功夫讲究后发制人，对方招数越用老，自己出手时收效越大，只等厉宏生掌缘挨近闵嘉庚身上，立即发招相救。

    突然青光一闪，厉宏生疾收左掌，侧身跃开相避。原来闵嘉庚跌倒时见身旁有半截剑头，正是李云那柄给震折的断剑，情急之下伸手抓起，向敌人拍下来的掌心刺去。这下掌法变幻，若非厉宏生躲闪得快，掌心给他刺个窟窿也不稀奇。闵嘉庚一招得手，立即一个打滚，左手在地下一捞，右手用断剑割下一块衣襟，裹了折断的剑刃，笑着说：“厉老板，我的手短，你的手长，咱二人比武太不公平。我把右手接长点儿，你若害怕，就取出紫金刀来好了。”
content_en:
Wang Wanhu took a step forward, stretched out his arm to cross the laochao, and took all the seven darts halfway.Copying hidden weapons is his best skill in life.Everyone's eyes were blurred and they didn't see clearly how he took action. Seven money darts were already in his hands.Under the candlelight, I saw that the tip of the dart was dark red. I brought it to my nose and smelled it. There was a sweet smell, and I knew that the tip of the dart was highly poisonous.He is a master of concealed weapons. He hates others feeding poison to concealed weapons. He often says: "Concealed weapons are originally decent weapons. From small to long, they are one of the three gates of martial arts along with fists, feet, and weapons. It's just feeding poison to shameless villains, which makes people look down on them."
He casually threw the seven money darts on the ground, turned around and glared at Mrs. Wen, and said: "Li Shiyu is such a hero. Did he teach people to use concealed weapons to feed poison? Did he teach people to do despicable sneak attacks? Let alone deal with a child in such a way." These words were so righteous that the Li brothers couldn't help but feel ashamed secretly.
Seeing the Li brothers lowering their heads, Mrs. Wen said loudly: "Who are you to come to Wenjiabao to bully others? I just lament that after my husband died, there are no more heroes in the Wanlan Group. My son is young and my wife is a womanizer, so I have to let you bully me." Suddenly she burst into tears and said: "Wenwei, after your death, Wanlan will only have a group of bears. They only know how to flatter outsiders, and no one with any backbone can give them anything.Let's take a breath.Hongwei, starting tomorrow, I will ask your son to switch to Tai Chi. Don't let him be disgraced in the world and be looked down upon all his life.Hongwei, if you had known you were like this, you should have brought this purple gold sword into the coffin to avoid making a fool of yourself here." She cried, cursed a few words, threw the purple gold sword in her hand to the ground, stepped on it, and spat.The Li brothers were filled with anger, but they couldn't argue with her in front of outsiders.
Wang Wanhu was eager to take Wei Congshan away, but seeing that Mrs. Wen used such vicious methods to deal with Min Jiageng, if he left, the child would be killed.Although he had nothing to do with Min Jiageng, how could he just ignore things when things were unfair?He cupped his fists to the Li brothers and said, "I will take this child with me today. I will thank you two for your kindness in the future."
Before Li Hongsheng could answer, Mrs. Wen cried again: "Hongwei, it would be better for you to die early, and you don't have to see such a shameful thing. One of your junior brothers is known as the master of Wanlan, but he can't fight against a ten-year-old child. He even let someone take away the sword that guarded the house. Your other junior brother is even more afraid of the child, and just hopes that he will leave as soon as possible..."
Li Hongsheng was so excited by her that he could no longer bear it and shouted: "Shut up!" He turned to Wang Wanhu and said: "Director Wang, you heard what my sister-in-law said just now. It's not that I won't give you this face today, but if this child is like thisIf the Wanlan Group is no longer able to gain a foothold in the world, it will be hard for our brothers to behave." Wang Wanhu thought to himself, "That's true." He asked Min Jiageng, "Son, why did you offend the two Masters?Come on, bow to me and let me go."
Wang Wanhu is experienced and experienced, but this time he said the wrong thing.He saw that Min Jiageng had just brought Mrs. Wen around. Although her skills were not weak, she was still a child. How could he know that Min Jiageng was naturally bold and humorous, so how could he be willing to bow to others easily?He smiled and said: "You asked him to kowtow to me and apologize? I don't dare to accept this." Wang Wanhu was stunned and thought to himself: "Why is this kid so talkative?"
Li Hongsheng originally wanted Min Jiageng to apologize and step down, but he didn't necessarily want him to kowtow. Hearing his answer, he felt very angry, but he didn't want to appear less restrained in front of Wang Wanhu, so he remained calm., said: "Little brother, your martial arts are really good, no wonder you are arrogant. Come on, Li will teach you a few moves." Min Jiageng jumped to the center of the hall, and punched Li Hongsheng in the nose.Li Hongsheng smiled slightly and returned the slap.
Li Hongsheng's palm was light and deft when it was struck out, but halfway through the palm, a strong gust of wind hit Min Jiageng in the face.Wang Wanhu thought to himself: "This person with the surname Li has a strong family background, and the strength of his palm is really extraordinary." He was afraid that Min Jiageng would be seriously injured with this palm, so he immediately leaned forward slightly, planning to slap Li Hongsheng in the back of the heart in an emergency to relieve the force of the palm.Unexpectedly, Min Jiageng's movement was extremely fast. When his upper body turned sideways, Li Hongsheng's palm had already missed.But Li Hongsheng was the best master of Wanlan in the world. He hit his left palm crookedly, and his right palm didn't stop and slashed diagonally from the upper right to the lower left.Min Jiageng raised his fists, and with a snap, the palm hit his fist.
Min Jiageng shouted: "Oh, it hurts!" Suddenly, he reached out to grab the Quchi point on his left hand. This move was so weird that Li Hongsheng was startled and jumped back.Mrs. Wen and Yue Sheng looked at each other and said in their hearts, "How come this kid can also do this weird move?" It turned out that Cao Hu robbed goods and used force with Yue Sheng that day. Among the more than ten weird moves, there was this "sinking elbow capture" move.
Li Hongsheng retreated and then advanced, using the "Tiger Ambush" move to cut Min Jiageng's left arm with his palm.Min Jiageng half-turned around and "hooked back kick", which was another strange move.Yue Sheng and others were certainly surprised by this, and even the well-informed Wang Wanhu was secretly surprised.Li Hongsheng saw the humiliation hidden in his moves and thought: "If I don't give you some trouble, people will underestimate the Wanlan Group." Although he fought with Min Jiageng, he did not regard this child as his opponent in his heart. Every move was exposed to the famous Wang Wanhu next to him, so he moved with dignity and roundness.Zhuan Ruyi did not dare to lose the slightest bit of his status as a famous master. He did not seek to be ruthless in his moves just because he was concerned about others. He was afraid that Wang Wanhu would look down upon him and said, "How can a disciple from a famous family be so impetuous?" In this way, although there was no flaw in his palm technique, he was unable to control the opponent in a few moves.
Wen Wenxin has been practicing Baguazhang since he was a child. He was secretly angry when he saw that this uncle's moves were mediocre and he only used the simplest tricks in Baguazhang. He also said that he was afraid of Wang Wanhu and was deliberately perfunctory and had no intention of repelling Min Jiageng.Little did he know that Li Hongsheng's ordinary palm skills contained decades of hard work. Min Jiageng was jumping around and making strange moves at first, but later he was completely enveloped by the opponent's palm wind.
Li Hongsheng used his palm force to gradually restrain Min Jiageng, causing every punch and kick he made to be pushed back by the force of his palm.It would not have been difficult for him to use all his strength to injure Min Jiageng at this time, but he deliberately showed off his skills in front of Wang Wanhu, so that Min Jiageng would be exhausted and kneel down to beg for mercy. However, he remained calm and behaved as if nothing had happened.It should be noted that the most difficult state to reach in martial arts is to lift a heavy weight with ease, to exert force without seeing any effort, and to exert strength without seeing effort.Every martial arts master strives for this realm until the end of his training.As for shouting, twisting, sweating and panting, that's definitely inferior skill.
Wang Wanhu knew his intentions. It seemed that the child's life was not in danger for the time being. It would depend on how long he could support him.Seeing that Min Jiageng could not help but be driven by the opponent's palm, he staggered and suddenly somersaulted, thrust his right hand on the ground and swept his legs.This time there was another strange move. Li Hongsheng jumped up to avoid it. Min Jiageng sat on the ground and kicked his legs upwards. In an instant, he kicked seven or eight legs, which was strange and quick.The boxing technique originally included a chain of mandarin duck kicks, but after kicking out with the left foot, the right foot followed and kicked. When the third kick was about to be kicked, one foot had to land on the ground first. Even the speed was limited. At this time, Min Jiageng was sitting on the ground, with his feet in the air, one after the other. His kicks were like lightning. Li Hongsheng was kicked so hard that he had to turn around and avoid it.
Yue Sheng and Mrs. Wen looked at each other again and both thought: "This strange move is not something Cao Hu knows. It seems that this kid has learned more martial arts than Cao Hu." Sure enough, Min Jiageng turned over and immediately pushed back with his elbows. At this time, his back was facing Li Hongsheng. He was short and moved quickly. Both elbow strikes actually hit Li Hongsheng's buttocks.His buttocks were fleshy and he was small and weak. Naturally, these two elbow strikes could not hurt the opponent, but the spectators couldn't help laughing.
Li Hongsheng was furious, turned around and struck him in the chest with his palm, but seeing his ferocious expression, he could no longer care about his coolness or magnanimity.Wang Wanhu secretly sighed in his heart: "Li Shiyu doesn't have as many sons as his father!" While he was watching the fight, Wei Congshan never left Wei Congshan in the corner of his eyes, and he would never let him wait for an opportunity to escape.
When Min Jiageng saw the opponent's palms coming at him like a storm, he couldn't help but be afraid. After all, the opponent was a top-notch master in the martial arts world. He relied on some strange moves in the secret book and relied on the opponent's ignorance and hesitation in taking action. He managed to hold on at this time, which was extremely difficult.In fact, these strange moves in the "Beidou Secrets" are used for practicing martial arts. They are designed to improve one's skills without seeking to defeat the enemy. The real moves against people are recorded in the first few pages of the cheats.Min Jiageng was not yet strong enough to understand, so he had to use these basic moves for training.
After fighting for more than ten moves, Min Jiageng felt embarrassed. Suddenly he saw Li Hongsheng's left palm piercing outwards. He immediately ducked to the right to avoid it, and Li Hongsheng's right palm struck diagonally with his "flying claw".This time, Min Jiageng was so anxious that he slumped down and slumped his shoulders. Although he had absorbed 70% of the force of the blow, he was still shaken by the force of his palm and fell down.
Amid everyone's exclamations, Li Hongsheng struck down with another palm.Wang Wanhu was furious and thought: "Thanks to you, you are a famous figure. You have defeated a child, so why do you still attack him?" His kung fu emphasizes on attacking later. The more used the opponent's tricks are, the more effective he will be. He waited until the edge of Li Hongsheng's palm came close to Min Jiageng and immediately launched a move to save him.
Suddenly there was a flash of blue light, Li Hongsheng quickly closed his left palm and jumped sideways to avoid it.It turned out that when Min Jiageng fell, he saw half of the sword head next to him. It was Li Yun's broken sword that was broken by the shock. In desperation, he reached out to grab it and stabbed the enemy's palm.This palm technique changed. If Li Hongsheng hadn't dodged quickly, it wouldn't be unusual for him to get a hole in his palm.As soon as Min Jiageng succeeded in the move, he immediately rolled around, fished it out with his left hand on the ground, and used his right hand to cut off a piece of clothing with a broken sword. He wrapped the broken blade of the sword and said with a smile: "Boss Li, my hands are short and your hands are long. It's not fair for us to compete. I'll make my right hand longer. If you're afraid, just take out the purple gold sword."
